author: cabumm
quote: people talk about how inteligent the npcs are, but i just dont feel it. every random event feels like youre just a telespectator, and you never really have a conversation with npcs. also, the limitations are really frustating, sometimes i just want to fail a mission on purpose and i just CANT do it, cause the helicopter somehow can survive being thrown directly into the ground at high speeds, this and not being able to rob strip clubs and kill certain npcs, like in the hospital mission where you can only shoot the bad guys, and if a doctor gets in your way, it just doesnt let you shoot, WTF? is this even gta anymore? the game punishes you for killing people, literally encouraging you to kill the least people possible. in a gta game. wow. I do like the game, but i cant rate it high because i dont want this to be the new normal for video games, where no one can feel ofended, this wave of optimistic crap where every time you tell a joke its like walking on eggshells.
